c.icon.accent-2.$description: Font colour's red bar: 01-home.png Font row 3 #EE0000.

c.icon.accent-3.$description: Bullets, numbers, sub/superscript, font grow/shrink and styles brush: 01-home.png #1E8BCD.

c.icon.accent-5.$description: Title bar Save icon (#9B40A3) and Clear formatting eraser: 01-home.png.

c.icon.accent-6.$description: Add-ins tiles (#DC4E1A) and Paste/Format Painter warm amber (#D48B28): 01-home.png.

c.icon.accent-7.$description: Editor nib, Text effects A and Share/PDF actions: 01-home.png #185ABD.

c.button.inherit-disabled.$description: Unavailable Undo/Redo on the Mica title bar: 01-home.png.

c.switch.track-inline-xs.$description: Title bar AutoSave switch: 84 px wide at ≈2× in w-theme-07, so 42 px; it holds the knob and the word Off.

c.switch.track-block-xs.$description: AutoSave switch: 40 px tall at ≈2× in w-theme-07, so 20 px.

c.switch.thumb-inset-xs.$description: AutoSave knob: 26 px across at ≈2× (13 px), so (20 − 13) / 2 = 3.5 px from the track on each side.

$description: Q145.W reference spec .design-library/word-ref/README.md: w-theme-07 (Colorful, 2x), w-theme-03 (Dark Gray, 2x), w-copilot-01 (near-full window, 1.28x). Type: Noto Sans (OFL) stands in for Segoe UI, which isn't openly licensed; Noto is about 5% wider at the same size (recorded difference). Dark values are the Dark Gray theme; unmeasured values are marked.

font.text.$description: UI and document type: Noto Sans OFL in place of Segoe UI and Aptos.

font.ui.$description: UI type: Noto Sans OFL in place of Segoe UI.

font.display.$description: Document title and headings: Noto Sans OFL in place of Aptos Display.

text.s.$description: Ribbon commands, group labels and the status bar: 9 pt (12 px), w-copilot-01.

text.m.$description: Tabs and title bar: 10 pt (13.33 px), w-theme-07 ('Insert' 32 px wide).

text.l.$description: Document body: 12 pt (16 px) at 100% zoom.

type.label.size.$description: Tabs and buttons in the chrome: 10 pt.

type.body-sm.size.$description: Small buttons and fields in the ribbon: 9 pt.

type.caption.size.$description: Group labels under the ribbon's commands: 9 pt.

type.caption.leading.$description: Group labels on a 16 px line (w-theme-07: label band about 32 image px at 2x).

type.label.weight.$description: Chrome labels are regular; the selected tab alone is bold.

c.tabs.item-size.$description: Tab row 30 CSS px (25 PNG px in 01-home.png y=39..63).

c.tabs.item-padding-inline.$description: Tab label inset: 8 px either side.

c.tabs.gap.$description: Tabs sit close: 2 px gap plus inline padding.

c.tabs.text.$description: Tab labels: 01-home.png #242424 on the frame; white on Dark Gray.

c.tabs.selected-text.$description: The selected tab keeps the label colour; weight and the underline mark it.

color.map.selection-indicator.$description: Selected-tab underline: 01-home.png #185ABD; Dark Gray light blue.

color.map.nav-shell.$description: Title bar: 01-home.png Windows 11 Mica #ECEFF2; Dark Gray #54585B.

color.map.nav-shell-on.$description: Title bar text and icons: #242424 on Windows 11 Mica (01-home.png); white on Dark Gray.

color.map.nav.$description: Document canvas warm neutral: 01-home.png #F2ECE7; Dark Gray #54585B.

color.accent.$description: Primary action and active selection accent (#185ABD).

color.bg.$description: Base window surface (#FAFAFA matching root so chrome sits at depth 0); #BDBDBD in Dark Gray.

color.bg-raised.$description: Ribbon card and panes: white (01-home.png); Dark Gray card #BDBDBD.

color.text-muted.$description: Secondary text (search placeholder, draft prompt, ruler digits).

color.border.$description: Hairlines on ribbon groups, search, draft pill, page and status bar (01-home.png #D9D9D9-#DEDEDE).

color.border-strong.$description: Unified subtle hairline role matching color.border so distinct strokes stay within VN4.

color.border-control.$description: Font and size fields, Comments and Editing outlines: w-theme-07 #8A8A8A.

color.bg-control.$description: Fields and outlined buttons are white in both themes (w-theme-03 card fields).

color.map.action-fill-hover.$description: Hover unmeasured: keeps the measured fill.

color.map.action-fill-pressed.$description: Pressed unmeasured: keeps the measured fill.

size.app-bar-height.$description: Title bar 46 CSS px (38 PNG px in 01-home.png y=1..38).

size.nav-width.$description: Navigation pane about 300 px (w-nav-pane, by eye).

size.pane-width.$description: Comments pane about 340 px (w-comments, by eye).

c.button.size-xs.$description: Small ribbon commands 22 CSS px so 3 rows + 16 px foot + 8 px padding = 96 CSS px (80 PNG px).

c.button.size-s.$description: Comments, Editing and Share 24 px (w-copilot-01 y2-32 at 1.28x).

c.button.radius-sm.$description: Ribbon buttons and fields 4 px (w-theme-07 font field).

c.ribbon.radius.$description: Ribbon card 8 px: the corner's first row starts 13 image px in at 2x (w-theme-07 rows 184-197).

c.ribbon.shadow.$description: In-flow ribbon card carries no floating shadow (ME3); separated by surface contrast over Mica.

c.ribbon.padding.$description: Card padding: 4 px inside the 96 CSS px ribbon card.

c.ribbon.gap.$description: The card sits right under the tab row.

c.menu-button.size-s.$description: Editing and Share 24 px, the same as Comments.

c.slider.hit-s.$description: Status bar zoom slider in the 21 px bar.

c.button.stack-padding.$description: Paste and the other lead commands fill the group's height with no extra padding.

c.ribbon.launcher-size.$description: Group launcher: 16 px box so 3 rows + foot + padding = 96 CSS px (80 PNG px).

c.ribbon.command-gap.$description: Dense ribbon command rows sit flush on 22 px targets.

c.ribbon.group-gap.$description: 4 px either side of a group's hairline.

c.button.stack-gap.$description: Paste: the label sits under the 32 px icon with no gap (w-theme-07).

leading.normal.$description: Document body: 1.15 multiple line spacing on a 1.2 font line, about 22 px at 12 pt.

color.text-accent-display.$description: Document heading colour (the default heading style's dark teal), unchanged on Dark Gray because the page stays white.

c.field.padding-inline-sm.$description: Ribbon font and size fields: the text starts 6 image px (≈5 CSS px) inside the 54 px size box in w-copilot-01 (≈1.25x), so a 43 px box shows "12" beside its chevron.

c.slider.thumb-s.$description: Zoom slider thumb: 14 image px tall in w-copilot-01 (x1368, y863-877, ≈1.25x), 11 px.

c.slider.thumb-aspect.$description: Zoom slider thumb: an upright bar 6 image px wide (x1366-1371), 5 px on an 11 px height.

c.slider.thumb-radius.$description: Zoom slider thumb: square-ended bar with a softened edge (antialiased corner pixels only), 1 px.

c.slider.thumb-fill.$description: Zoom slider thumb unified with track grey #686868.

c.slider.track-s.$description: Zoom slider line: 1 image px (y871) at ≈1.25x, so a hairline.

c.slider.track-fill.$description: Zoom slider line #686868 either side of the thumb (w-copilot-01 y871, x1306-1430); one value for both themes, as the thumb.

c.slider.fill.$description: Word's zoom line has no fill: the same grey on both sides of the thumb (w-copilot-01).
